name: Birth Pains
overview: The Bible portrays birth pains as a symbol of both physical suffering and divine consequence, beginning with God's declaration to the woman that childbirth would come with multiplied sorrow (Genesis 3:16). This imagery is further used prophetically to describe the distress and anticipation experienced by God's people, likened to a woman in labor nearing delivery (Isaiah 26:17). In the New Testament, Jesus describes the signs preceding His return as 'the beginning of sorrows' (Matthew 24:8), indicating that the trials before the end times resemble birth pains—intense but purposeful, culminating in the glorious coming of the Son of Man (Matthew 24:30). Thus, birth pains in Scripture signify both the pain of judgment and the hope of redemption through Christ.
